intent: TelemetryRecordStore is the outbound port over raw records and event revisions: insert-only operations, no update or delete member. Latest-revision lookup by identity classifies retry versus correction; readPage is a keyset read by t_device with a bounded limit.

methods.signature: Mono<Void> appendRevision(TelemetrySample sample, int revisionNumber, String reason)
Mono<Integer> findLatestRevisionNumber(String deviceId, String metric, Instant tDevice)
Flux<TelemetrySample> readPage(String deviceId, String metric, Instant afterTDevice, int limit)
methods.semantics: limit is positive and at most the configured maximum page size
